notes: NNS-python consumes accepted NNS-core snapshots for native code and verifies public Python behavior against live or cached R NNS. r_commit/r_version record the R commit that generated the committed parity cache: 13.3 Beta d14beb6 plus the NNS.VAR change on OVVO-Financial/NNS branch claude/trusting-allen-usj1cz, which restores NNS 11.6's relevant-variable and NNS.stack(stack = TRUE) semantics inside NNS.VAR. It differs from d14beb6 only in R/NNS_VAR.R, its Rd and package tests, so only the NNS.VAR shards changed. The vendored native snapshot (tools/NNS, r_src_tree_hash, tarball) and NNS-core commit are left at their prior values; re-syncing the native snapshot is a separate NNS-core snapshot update.
